chunks: Your Lord would not surely destroy unjustly human habitations so long as the people are righteous.
ai.seo_question: Why does God destroy communities according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to refute the notion of arbitrary divine punishment, emphasizing that Allah's justice requires a threshold of collective moral decay before calamity strikes. It underscores the principle that righteous individuals are not punished for the sins of the corrupt, a concept central to the Shia understanding of divine fairness and the gradual nature of prophetic warnings.
